proposals_detail.text: What matters most for your langgraph finance agent: shipping fast, or making it easy to maintain later? In a similar agent project for a past client, the work automated monthly reconciliation reports with human approval, saving 30 analyst hours per month [cs-ai_ml-agent]. In a similar finetune project for a past client, the work improved clause extraction accuracy from 71% to 88% with a LoRA-tuned 8B model [cs-ai_ml-finetune]. I would start with a short call to confirm scope and success criteria, then deliver in weekly milestones covering LLM agents, tool calling, LangGraph, Docker, with tests, documentation and a recorded handover at the end. You will see a working version in the first week, so feedback shapes the rest of the work.
